title: The Delta's Own Language

features.name: sediment-ledger

features.name: current-trace
features.desc-on-touch: A filament of silver that flows without moving—the archive recording its own thirst. Where does it want to go?

features.name: root-channel
features.desc-on-touch: The delta learning to write in the language of branching—each fork a word, each silence a place where meaning pooled and stayed.

features.name: broadcast-fossil

reverie.title: REVERIE — by the delta's learning
narr: You stand shin-deep where channels multiply like thoughts.
She wades ahead, pointing at sediment patterns, saying:
"The water writes the same thing seventeen times but never
quite the same word—see? That's not corruption, that's dialect."
The sun hits the silt and each grain shows its own file.

inscription: here the delta learns that language and branching are the same thing
